title: "Foresight Fulfilled"
next_chapter_hook: After the crowd dispersed, a cold voice sounded behind Chen Ji: 'Your eyes don't look like those of a waste.'

text.content: At the third quarter of the Chen hour, on the Blue Stone Path beside the Tianqing Sect Martial Arena, Chen Ji walked slowly with a hunched back. He walked very slowly, each step seeming to measure something—this was how a废物 should walk, careful with every step, as if afraid to crush an ant on the ground. Only he himself knew that those downcast eyes were rapidly calculating: thirty zhang ahead, at the turn where the moss was thickest, was the exact path Zhao Yue took every day after finishing morning practice.

dialogue.content: (Muttering to himself) In one incense stick's time, you will step on that loose stone slab; three breaths later, you will lose balance; two breaths after that... you will 'accidentally' bump open that ajar side door.

text.content: He stopped at the corner, squatted down, and wiped the dew from the edge of a Blue Stone slab with his sleeve. To others, this was merely a servant disciple cleaning road debris. But Chen Ji's fingers lightly pressed the side of the slab—the mechanism had been triggered, merely waiting for the prey to enter the trap. Having finished this, he stood up, brushed the dust from his knees, and continued forward with his hunched posture.

He didn't look back. But that faint, barely perceptible curve at the corner of his mouth said everything. Zhao Yue, don't you want to make an example of me? After today, the entire Tianqing Sect will know who the real joke is.

choice.prompt: The trap has been set, but Chen Ji can choose whether to add another layer of protection.

choices.description: Place a bucket of dirty water behind the side door, letting Zhao Yue fall into it and get thoroughly soaked—a double humiliation
choices.visible_cost: Consume one more strand of mental energy
choices.risk_hint: If traces are discovered, may be investigated
choices.process_label: 陈机悄悄在门后放下水桶

text.content: As Chen Ji turned to leave, his fingers lightly traced through the void. The water bucket behind the door had been quietly moved by him to the exact spot where Zhao Yue would step—this set of interlocking mechanisms was carefully calculated based on Zhao Yue's habit of putting slightly more weight on his right foot when walking. Waste? No, he knew Zhao Yue's weaknesses better than anyone.

choices.description: Leave only the stone slab trap, which is enough to make Zhao Yue publicly humiliate himself—no need to gild the lily
choices.visible_reward: No evidence left behind, more covert
choices.risk_hint: Effect may not be impactful enough

text.content: Enough. Chen Ji turned and left—could a waste have any ill intentions? He merely bumped open a door. As for what was behind it, that was Zhao Yue's own bad luck. The price of foresight had been paid; now he only needed to wait for the harvest.

At the beginning of the Si hour, the stands beside the Martial Arena were already filled with disciples. Today was the monthly assessment day for Outer Disciples. Zhao Yue, as an exchange student borrowed from the Xuanwu Sect, had been specially arranged for a sparring exhibition match. His opponents were several Tianqing Sect Outer Disciples—a match with no suspense whatsoever, a perfect opportunity to bring honor to the Xuanwu Sect.

Chen Ji sat in the farthest corner of the stands, head lowered, fiddling with his broom. He was waiting—for Zhao Yue to step onto the arena with grand ambitions, to wave to the audience with high spirits, for that arrogant posture of looking at people through their noses. Everything was proceeding as planned. And he, he only needed to wait for that foreseen moment.

dialogue.content: (Inner thoughts) Here he comes. Zhao Yue cupped his hands toward the crowd below, then turned to walk toward the Arena Platform. His route... west side of the arena, around that old locust tree, through the Blue Stone Path. Perfect.

text.content: The crowd's clamor suddenly fell silent. Chen Ji looked up and saw Zhao Yue stepping onto the Arena Platform, the golden Xuanwu Sect attire gleaming under the sunlight. His opponents—the three Tianqing Sect Outer Disciples—stood at the platform with heads bowed, like prisoners awaiting judgment. Zhao Yue drew his long sword, the tip quivering, spiritual power surging, and a faint Xuanwu phantom flickered around him.

dialogue.content: (Whispering) Look, this is the might of a Xuanwu Sect genius. In three months, he will shine throughout the entire cultivation world. But today... he will only become a laughingstock.

text.content: The match began. The outcome was，毫无悬念—Zhao Yue defeated his first opponent in three moves, knocked down the second in five, and the third didn't even dare step onto the platform, directly conceding. The crowd erupted in cheers. Zhao Yue triumphantly waved to the audience, especially toward the Inner Sect area where the team leader and several elders were seated.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji needs to decide how to act next.

choices.description: Proceed as planned—trigger the trap when Zhao Yue leaves the Arena Platform and departs via the west path
choices.risk_hint: If Zhao Yue temporarily changes route, the plan may fail
choices.process_label: 陈机继续低头扫地，实则竖起耳朵

text.content: He knew these geniuses too well. After victory, they would never return to their seats immediately, but instead take detours to patrol their territory, displaying the victor's posture to everyone. Zhao Yue would definitely stop on the path, wave to a few familiar disciples. And at that moment, the trap would spring.

choices.description: Move closer to the Arena Platform, observe Zhao Yue's condition and surrounding environment, look for better opportunities
choices.process_label: 陈机悄悄向比武台方向移动

text.content: Chen Ji swept the floor, secretly moving toward the Arena Platform. He needed to confirm Zhao Yue's state—victory often made people relax their guard, but arrogant geniuses were the exception. They would become even more vigilant after victory, like beasts showing off their spoils, constantly on guard against anyone coming to steal.

At the third quarter of the Si hour, the match ended. Zhao Yue sheathed his sword, and as expected, didn't return directly to his seat, instead walking toward the west Blue Stone Path. That path led to the sect's Meditation Pavilion, and going the long way around恰好 could show his victor's posture to more people. Several Xuanwu Sect disciples followed behind him, laughter unceasing.

Chen Ji's eyes narrowed slightly. Here it comes. The instant Zhao Yue stepped on that Blue Stone slab, his right foot pressed down slightly—his body's instinct wanted to stabilize his center of gravity, but Chen Ji had calculated his stride and force; that momentary shift of balance was enough to send his entire body pitching forward.

"Bang—!" A dull thud. Zhao Yue sprawled on the ground, limbs flailing, utterly undignified. The several Xuanwu Sect disciples behind him froze for a moment, then burst into laughter. And this wasn't even the end—he had fallen in the direction of that ajar side door. Behind the door was the mud and dirty water accumulated during the sect's debris cleanup.

"Splash—!!" Zhao Yue crashed through the side door, tumbling into the mud. A pungent stench instantly filled the air. He struggled to get up, but the combination of limbs flailing and being covered in mud made him only more狼狈. Mud splashed across his face and body; the golden Xuanwu Sect attire instantly turned into the color of a mud puddle.

dialogue.content: (Whispering) This is the price of your mockery of废物. Remember today, remember this smell.

text.content: The disciples on the stands were first deathly silent, then erupted in laughter. Some laughed until they doubled over, others pointed and whispered, and some were already gossiping amongst themselves. The Xuanwu Sect's number one genius, the honored guest of the Tianqing Sect, was now thrashing about in the mud like a drowned chicken.

Chen Ji still kept his head lowered, the broom making rustling sounds on the ground. But his lips could no longer be hidden.废物? Zhao Yue, oh Zhao Yue, you think you defeated me, but you don't know—you are the biggest joke of today. The crowd's gaze had shifted from the Arena Platform to the path, and those original mocking remarks aimed at him had all turned into mockery of Zhao Yue.

dialogue.content: (Distant voice) Interesting. The Xuanwu Sect's genius was actually tripped by a Blue Stone slab.

text.content: The voice was cold, yet carried unmistakable mockery. Chen Ji's broom paused slightly—that was Su Qingyao, the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of the Tianqing Sect, and the only person in this sect he needed to be wary of. Her gaze swept across the crowd and finally landed on Chen Ji in the corner, her brow slightly furrowing.

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao seems to have noticed something. Chen Ji needs to decide how to respond.

choices.text: Continue pretending to be a废物
choices.description: Sweep the floor with head lowered, as if nothing happened, giving her no flaw to exploit
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao is very perceptive, may see through
choices.process_label: 陈机更加卖力地扫地，头低得更深

text.content: He swept even more vigorously, his hunched back seeming to curve even more. A typical废物, facing such a scene, would only hide far away, afraid of being implicated. He performed excellently—at least that's what he thought. But Su Qingyao's gaze was like a thorn, making his back faintly cold.

choices.description: Deliberately let her see the curve at the corner of his mouth, test her reaction
choices.visible_reward: Observe Su Qingyao's attitude toward himself
choices.risk_hint: May make her even more suspicious
choices.process_label: 陈机不经意地抬起头，与苏青瑶目光相交

text.content: He raised his head, his gaze meeting Su Qingyao's. He didn't dodge, but instead smiled faintly—that was a pure smile of someone enjoying the show, open and honest enough to find no fault with. But in that instant, Su Qingyao's eyes narrowed slightly, as if re-examining something.

Beside the path, Zhao Yue had crawled out of the mud. He was soaked through, mud dripping from his hair and clothes, thoroughly disheveled. Several Xuanwu Sect disciples tried to step forward and help him up, but he shoved them away—at this moment, Zhao Yue's face was written with boundless fury and endless humiliation.

"Who?!" Zhao Yue roared, his voice sharp with rage. "Who tampered with something here?!" His gaze swept over everyone present, finally landing on Chen Ji, who was sweeping the floor nearby. "It was you! It must have been you, you废物!"

dialogue.content: (Looking up, utterly bewildered) Me? I've been sweeping the floor this whole time. How did Zhao Shixiong fall? Oh my, what do we do, why is there so much mud behind this door, who dumped it here?

text.content: Chen Ji's performance was flawless. He stepped back in apparent terror, nearly dropping the broom from his hands, eyes slightly reddened, looking like a frightened little animal. Several surrounding disciples had already begun whispering: "What does this have to do with Chen Ji?" "The guy was sweeping the whole time." "Zhao Yue can't handle losing?"

Zhao Yue trembled with rage, but couldn't find any evidence. He indeed had no evidence—Chen Ji was merely a servant disciple, a废物 who couldn't even gather spiritual power, how could he possibly have the ability to set such a trap? Besides, there were so many eyes watching. If he laid hands on a废物, it would be even more embarrassing if word got out.

The crowd gradually dispersed, but the mockery lingered endlessly. Chen Ji watched Zhao Yue's retreating figure, surrounded by Xuanwu Sect disciples, with complete calm in his heart.废物? He had never been a废物. He simply understood patience better than anyone. Three years. He had been a废物 in the Tianqing Sect for three years, swept floors for three years, yet never forgot his goal.

The Tianji Record Fragment in his embrace pulsed with warmth—this was his greatest trump card. The foresight ability within three hours allowed him to see through countless schemes and intrigues, and also allowed him to set this vast net. Zhao Yue was merely the first target on which he tested his skills. The real chess game had just begun.

Chen Ji continued sweeping the floor with his head lowered, as if nothing had happened. But just then, a cold voice came from behind him, making his movements pause slightly. "Chen Ji." Su Qingyao had somehow walked up behind him, her voice carrying a hint of inquiry. "Your eyes don't look like those of a废物."

Chen Ji didn't turn around. He continued sweeping the floor slowly with his hunched back, as if completely unaware of these words. But his heart sank in that instant. Su Qingyao, the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of the Tianqing Sect, possessor of a Heaven-Spirit Root, the number one among the younger generation of the sect. She was the only person who had sensed something wrong with Chen Ji, and the greatest variable in his grand scheme of world domination.

dialogue.content: (Calmly) What is Senior Sister Su talking about? I'm just a floor sweeper—what eyes could a废物 possibly have?

text.content: He didn't turn around, merely continued sweeping. The broom rustled on the ground, like some kind of hypnotic rhythm. Su Qingyao's gaze lingered on his back for a moment, then lightly snorted and turned to leave. But Chen Ji knew this matter wouldn't end here. She had already taken notice; from today forward, she would watch him more closely.

Chen Ji finally stopped his movements. He raised his head, watching Su Qingyao's departing figure, a complex emotion flickering in his eyes. Three times now. This was the first time she had become suspicious of him. In the original foresight, this should have happened two months later. It seemed the Zhao Yue incident had accelerated the development.

However, this was within controllable bounds. Chen Ji lowered his head again and continued sweeping. Su Qingyao might be clever, but she could never imagine he possessed something as heaven-defying as the Tianji Record. She would only think he was a "废物 with eyes that don't match"—nothing more. As for the truth—with absolute power, all suspicion is futile.

Today's battle had thoroughly cemented the name of废物 Chen Ji. No one would suspect a servant disciple who had been publicly humiliated by Zhao Yue. But Chen Ji knew the real victor was always the one who laughed last. Zhao Yue's failure was merely a beginning. In the days to come, he would let everyone know what a true "废物" really meant.

The sky gradually darkened, and the disciples at the Martial Arena dispersed one by one. Chen Ji put away his broom and walked toward the Servants' Quarters with his hunched posture. His steps were still slow, like a withered tree that could fall at any moment. But beneath that withered exterior, a burning heart was pulsing. The Tianji Record Fragment in his embrace pulsed with warmth—this was his sole reliance for changing his fate, and the starting point of his revenge.

废物? Chen Ji coldly smiled in his heart. When the day comes when my scheme is complete, all of you will know who the real废物 is. The crowd had dispersed, leaving only the setting sun's afterglow bathing the empty Martial Arena. And just then, a cold voice sounded behind Chen Ji: "Your eyes don't look like those of a废物." Su Qingyao's footsteps stopped nearby, as if waiting for something.
